THE SCENE
You make the school podcast. Today, forty people become U.S. citizens in your school gym. Your show asks where America's big ideas came from. It also asks where those ideas went. You need four facts for the show. Four people at the event can each help you.
THE HISTORY
This show is about one big idea. All people are born with rights. America wrote it down in 1776. The idea did not start or stop in America.
